items.storagenetwork.kabel:guide: Network cable basic only connects to network blocks
items.storagenetwork.storage_kabel:guide: Each Link Cable connects one inventory to the network.  These are the main connection point for inventories in your network, with no controls for priority or automation.  Upgrade to  $(l:filter_kabel)Filtered version$(/l)
items.storagenetwork.export_kabel:guide: While connected to an inventory, these export items from the network to the target inventory.  Has priority settings for sort order among other export cables, and optional redstone control.  Accepts upgrades.
items.storagenetwork.import_kabel:guide: These constantly import from the connected inventory into the network.  Upgrade to  $(l:import_filter_kabel)filtered version$(/l) for more automation
items.storagenetwork.import_filter_kabel:guide: These constantly import from the connected inventory into the network.  They can be customized with upgrades, an item filter, and redstone controls in the GUI control screen.  Item Filter Allow means only items matching the filter will pass, Ignore mode means pull anything but ignore what is in the list.  Importing the filter wipes and replaces it with inventory contents
items.storagenetwork.filter_kabel:guide: Each Link Cable connects one inventory to the network.  Has priority settings for sort order among other export cables, and accepts upgrades.
items.storagenetwork.master:guide: The main heart of the network. Only ONE per network, Placing more will cause one of them to break, and may cause network connection issues for remotes and cables.  Moving the root node to a new place will break the network, interrupting imports, exports, and remotes.  Multiple networks per world and dimension are fine as long as they are not connected to each other
items.storagenetwork.request:guide: Views the network inventory with full access to scroll, withdraw, and deposit items.  Custom crafting grid that pulls ingredients from the network.   See the $(l:crafting_remote)Remote version here$(/l)
items.storagenetwork.request:tooltip: Used to overview and request items from the network with a crafting grid
items.storagenetwork.request_expanded:guide: If this is unuseable for you set your GUI SCALE to a lower number.  May only work with large scale monitor resolutions.  Views the network inventory with full access to scroll, withdraw, and deposit items.  Custom crafting grid that pulls ingredients from the network.   See the $(l:crafting_remote)Remote version here$(/l)
items.storagenetwork.request_expanded:tooltip: Only for use with extremely large gui scale resolutions
items.storagenetwork.expanded_remote:tooltip: Only for use with extremely large gui scale resolutions
items.storagenetwork.expanded_remote:guide: If this is unuseable for you set your GUI SCALE to a lower number.  May only work with large scale monitor resolutions.  Full remote network access, not limited by range or dimension.  Similar to the $(l:inventory)Storage Inventory$(/l).  Open this also using the Key Binding
items.storagenetwork.inventory:guide: Views the network inventory with full access to scroll, withdraw, and deposit items.  See the $(l:inventory_remote)Remote version here$(/l)
items.storagenetwork.inventory:tooltip: Inventory access without a crafting grid
items.storagenetwork.exchange:guide: This exposes the network as an inventory interface.  For example, the AE2 mod has a ME Storage Bus that will connect to this, so the entire simple storage network can be accessed through your AE2 system.  A Hopper below will export arbitrary items.  Try this with other storage mods!
items.storagenetwork.exchange:tooltip: Endpoint of the network for inventory connections
items.storagenetwork.collector:guide: This exposes the network and acts as an insert-only controller for other automation systems or storage solutions.  For example, a normal Hopper will insert items similar to the  $(l:import_kabel)Import Cable$(/l).  Does not allow any item extraction.  Try this with other storage mods!
items.storagenetwork.speed_upgrade:guide: This upgrade can be placed in cables.  Increases the speed of imports, which normally do not happen every tick. by decreasing the tick delay between operations.  Will cause any Slowness upgrades to be ignored if both are present.
items.storagenetwork.operation_upgrade:tooltip: Process the amount of items in the filter; can override other upgrades
items.storagenetwork.operation_upgrade:guide: If this is in a filtering cable with AllowMode on, it will try to import or export the exact number of items set in the filter and ignore Stack and Stock upgrades.  For example, a filter with 7 stone and 3 dirt allowed will export that many per cycle instead of the default 4.
items.storagenetwork.stack_upgrade:tooltip: Increases the stack size of task
items.storagenetwork.stack_upgrade:guide: This upgrade can be placed in the import or exporting cables.  Increases it to pulling a full stack up to 64 every time the cable fires, instead of 4
items.storagenetwork.single_upgrade:tooltip: Sets stack size of the task to 1
items.storagenetwork.single_upgrade:guide: This upgrade can be placed in the import or exporting cables.  Decreases it to pulling 1 every time the cable fires instead of 4. Will override the Stack upgrade if both are present
items.storagenetwork.slow_upgrade:tooltip: Slows down the speed of importing/exporting
items.storagenetwork.slow_upgrade:guide: This upgrade can be placed in the import or exporting cables.  Increases ticks between each operation which slows down the overall process.
items.storagenetwork.stock_upgrade:tooltip: Keeps a a consistent stock of items in the attached inventory
items.storagenetwork.stock_upgrade:guide: If this is in an export cable, then for each unique item in the filter, it will only export until the target inventory has less then the stack size of the filter to fill it up to the target size from the filter.  In the opposite way, Import cables with a stock upgrade will keep a consistent stock in the linked chest based, reducing it down and stopping at the filter stack sizes.
items.storagenetwork.builder_remote:tooltip: Bind to a network and a block to build
items.storagenetwork.builder_remote:guide: This remote binds as normal but does not have a screen.  Instead, it searches for the block you clicked on, and tries to build a copy of it using a matching item in the network

items.storagenetwork.inventory_remote:guide: Full remote network access, not limited by range or dimension.  Similar to the $(l:inventory)Storage Inventory$(/l).  Open this also using the Key Binding
items.storagenetwork.crafting_remote:tooltip: Use on the Network Root for remote inventory access
items.storagenetwork.crafting_remote:guide: Full network access, not limited by range or dimension.  Has an integrated crafting grid.  Similar to the $(l:request)Request Table$(/l)
items.storagenetwork.picker_remote:tooltip: Tapping on a block will pull matching blocks from the network
items.storagenetwork.picker_remote:guide: This remote binds as normal but does not have a screen.  Instead, tap this item in the world on a block.  This will request either 1 or a full stack of that block, depending on if you are crouching.
items.storagenetwork.collector_remote:tooltip: Items picked up are moved into the network
items.storagenetwork.collector_remote:guide: Bind this to the network as normal.  This remote works anywhere in your inventory (including curios but not ender chest), no need to hold it in hand or hotbar.  When you pickup any item, this will insert that item into the network if possible

items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_1: We arrived at the location He sent us to just before last dusk, a march of many days. One last time, we slept on the dirt; this morning we rose with purpose anew, beginning to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.
items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_2: Construction is near complete. As I write, supplies make their way into our hospice - freshly hewn wood from the area, a shipment of glass from fort greater. Discovery awaits.
items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_3: I had never thought it possible, this magic seems to be messing with my mind. I swear there used to be a cellar below the chapel, yet even my second in command says it were never so... Surely I cannot be the one going mad?
items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_4: Scouts have returned with fantastic news, that of a village, and not too far to return the supplies here with ease after laying siege. However, magical research in this area seems to be inconclusive. We may be abandoning soon.
items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_1:: We reached the location to which He bade us journey, a laborious march spanning many days. As the sun surrendered to dusk, we rested our wearied bodies upon the earth for what I trust to be the final time. This morn,
we rose with purpose anew, and began to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.
items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_2:: Our construction draws nigh its completion. As I pen these very words, the final shipment of supplies flow into our haven - enough timber, freshly hewn from the surrounding wilds, to finish the enclosure, and panes of glass
sent from Fort Greater. Soon shall the research commence, the likes of which may yet shake the pillars of the world.
items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_3:: A strange unease takes root within my mind. This magic - though wondrous - doth twist the senses. I could have sworn there was a cellar beneath the chapel's floor, and yet now none recall it. Even my most trusted lieutenant
claims such a thing never was. Am I alone in this delusion? Has madness begun to gnaw at me?
items.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_4:: Our scouts return with tidings of a village, not far from our encampment. This is good news, for supplies dwindle. We shall lay siege and easily procure what is needed, for the distance is not great.
However, the magical research in these lands proves troublesome - few are the answers we seek. It may soon come to pass that we abandon this place, move to the next site.

fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_1: Nous sommes arrivés à l'endroit qu'Il nous avait indiqué juste avant le dernier crépuscule, après une marche de plusieurs jours. Pour la dernière fois, nous avons dormi sur la terre ; ce matin nous nous sommes levés avec un regain de détermination, commençant à ériger une barrière de rondins et une demeure de pierre.
fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_2: La construction est presque achevée. Pendant que j'écris, les provisions arrivent dans notre hospice - du bois fraîchement coupé dans les environs, un envoi de verre depuis le fort principal. La découverte attend.
fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_3: Je n'aurais jamais cru cela possible, cette magie semble perturber mon esprit. Je jure qu'il y avait autrefois une cave sous la chapelle, et pourtant même mon second dit qu'il n'en a jamais été ainsi... Sûrement, ce n'est pas moi qui perds la raison ?
fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log:page_4: Les éclaireurs sont revenus avec de fantastiques nouvelles, celles d'un village, et pas trop loin pour ramener facilement les provisions ici après avoir mis le siège. Cependant, la recherche magique dans cette zone semble peu concluante. Nous pourrions bientôt abandonner.
fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_1:: Nous avons atteint le lieu vers lequel Il nous avait ordonné de voyager, une marche laborieuse s'étendant sur de nombreux jours. Alors que le soleil cédait au crépuscule, nous avons posé nos corps fatigués sur la terre pour ce que je crois être la dernière fois. Ce matin,
nous nous sommes levés avec un regain de détermination, et avons commencé à ériger une barrière de rondins et une demeure de pierre.
fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_2:: Notre construction approche de son achèvement. Pendant que je couche ces mots sur le papier, le dernier envoi de provisions afflue dans notre refuge - assez de bois, fraîchement coupé dans les contrées alentour, pour finir l'enceinte, et des vitres
envoyées depuis le Fort Principal. Bientôt commencera la recherche, dont l'ampleur pourrait encore ébranler les piliers du monde.
fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_3:: Un étrange malaise prend racine dans mon esprit. Cette magie - bien que merveilleuse - distord les sens. J'aurais pu jurer qu'il y avait une cave sous le plancher de la chapelle, et pourtant nul ne s'en souvient. Même mon lieutenant le plus fidèle
affirme qu'une telle chose n'a jamais existé. Suis-je seul dans cette illusion ? La folie a-t-elle commencé à me ronger ?
fr.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.entry_4:: Nos éclaireurs reviennent avec des nouvelles d'un village, non loin de notre campement. C'est une bonne nouvelle, car les provisions s'amenuisent. Nous mettrons le siège et procurerons facilement ce dont nous avons besoin, car la distance n'est pas grande.

Cependant, la recherche magique dans ces terres se révèle difficile - les réponses que nous cherchons sont rares. Il se pourrait bientôt que nous abandonnions cet endroit pour nous rendre au site suivant.
